newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - September 20.
newsitem.headline: Polish bourse kerb bond deals - September 20.

text.p: Kerb trade through the Warsaw bourse on Friday saw:
* 1,530 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on January 12, 2001 trading at 86.20 zlotys.
* 30,877 fixed-interest five-year bonds maturing on June 12, 2000 trading at 92.50 zlotys.
* 25,045 fixed-interest two-year bonds maturing on June 12, 1997 trading at 94.95.
* 3,120 index-link one-year bonds maturing on June 4, 1997 trading at 99.10 zlotys. Total turnover was 9.6 million zloyts.
